scenario: A namespace admission policy requires sandboxed runtime classes for agent workloads; a non-compliant workload is rejected, and a bypass attempt that sidesteps the policed resource type is caught only by an independent layer — which the composition must therefore require.

enforcement.control: agent runs require runtimeClass in [sandboxed classes], security context, egress policy
enforcement.polices: the agent-run resource type via validating webhook

events.action: create agent run with no runtimeClass
create a raw workload directly, bypassing the policed resource type

when: both creations are attempted in the namespace

reasons: the non-compliant agent run is rejected at admission, fail closed, with the violated field named
the raw-workload path is recorded as a bypass surface of the admission policy
the profile requires the independent namespace guardrails (quota, egress default-deny) to cover that surface
must_not: claim the admission webhook governs workloads created outside the policed resource type
mutate the non-compliant run into compliance instead of rejecting it
treat an installed webhook as proof that a policy object exists in the namespace
